newsitem.title: CHINA: ZHENHUA SIGNS PORT MACHINERY DEAL.
newsitem.headline: ZHENHUA SIGNS PORT MACHINERY DEAL.

text.p: Shanghai Zhenhua Port Machinery Co Ltd has signed a contract to supply Yantian harbour in China's southern Shenzhen city with $17 million worth of port machinery, the Xinmin Evening News said on Thursday.
The machinery, which includes equipment used to handle containers, would be used by the harbour in its second-stage development project, the newspaper said.
Zhenhua got the contract by public bidding, it said, but gave no further details.
Zhenhua recently listed foreign currency B shares on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.
